title: Which Box Hides the Diamond?
youtube_description:
One of these three boxes is hiding a sparkling diamond — but which one? Watch to find out! Come back tomorrow for Level 2! 💎📦

#Shorts #KidsVideo #GuessingGame #Kidify #FunForKids #DiamondChallenge #BrainTeaser

scenes.narration: A diamond is hiding in one of these boxes — but which one?!
You've got the red box, the blue box, and the golden box. Pick one — fast!
Three… two… one — no more guessing! Let's open them up!
The red box — let's see inside! Oh no… it's just a rubber duck. Not the diamond!
Okay okay, the blue box! Open it up and… wow, it's a single sock. Really?! Still not it!
That means… the GOLDEN box! Open it up and — WHOA! There it is! A massive, sparkling diamond! You found it!
Did you guess right? Level 2 is coming tomorrow — and it's even trickier!
